pairs.evidence: lib/decision/v1/types.ts:330 Each adapter previews from v1's own planners and folds a digest of the v1 state it read into the commit token, so a commit over a v1 that moved is refused. The apply half is idempotent on the same outcome and refuses a conflicting one loudly.

techniques.evidence: lib/decision/v1/types.ts:330 The decision binds to the exact decisions and to a content digest (media sha256) of what was previewed.
lib/decision/v1/sources/article.ts:262 The preview refuses unless the v1 gate is still pending; illegal states are conflicts.
lib/decision/v1/sources/article.ts:401 A duplicate of the same verdict succeeds; a conflicting one is refused. These paths are kept separate, as the technique requires.
lib/decision/v1/sources/article.ts:286 The outward effect is disclosed from the bound action (slug, branch, PR title) before commit.
lib/decision/v1/registry.ts:62 The queue is complete by construction: a packet source with no adapter line is a compile error.
lib/decision/v1/sources/dojo.ts:297 A claim needs its blind picks (the independent read) before the Board can change it.
lib/decision/v1/types.ts:55 A record that does not fit the kernel's vocabulary is carried with a named loss, not absorbed silently.
lib/decision/v1/sources/forge.ts:63 The admitting outcome (proven) is minted only by a human; a model's keep is recorded as the agent's.
